name: Glob

pattern.description: Glob relative to the search root. Includes hidden paths; `*` and `?` match across `/`. Narrow with path or a literal prefix.

path.description: Search directory, absolute or relative to cwd; defaults to cwd.

description:
[MCP:peri] Find files by path pattern, sorted by modification time.

Usage: Wildcards cross directory separators. Use a literal prefix or path to scope the search. Hidden paths are included; ignore files are not consulted. Common build/cache directories and symlink entries are skipped. Truncated results may be saved, but the saved list can still be incomplete; narrow the search root or pattern if needed.
